newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 1.46 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 1.46 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 1,465,200 lbs of frozen pork products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other federal programs.

AMS said it bought frozen coarse ground pork for reprocessing from four of six bidders at prices ranging from $1.1297 to 1.1853 per lb. Deliveries are to be in two periods between November 18 and December 13, 1996.

Winning bidders were Aksarben Foods Inc (Omaha NE) 79,200 lbs, Bo Packing Co (Chicago IL) 396,600 lbs, H&H Meat Products Inc (Mercedes TX) 118,800 lbs, and IBP Inc (Storm Lake IA and Columbus Junction IA) 871,200 lbs.
